100% of renewal quotes released in the month (census) are checked for lead-time compliance; no sampling.

Calculation mismatches (rating vs. posted premium), missing factors, or authority breaches are logged and corrected/referred before bind; disposition recorded, owner = Senior Underwriter.
Filed rate/rule version and all applied factor tables effective on the policy date, executed in Earnix Rating & Pricing.
Total premium re-checked by re-running the calculation with the largest single factor removed to confirm no data-entry error dominates.
A premium discrepancy is material at ≥ 1% of total or any amount crossing an authority threshold; such cases require re-check and sign-off.
100% of accounts final-rated in the period (census); each total independently re-computed for check.

PASS = final premium built from the filed rate version and correct exposures/factors, reconciling across Earnix, PolicyCenter and billing. FAIL = wrong rate version, missing factor, or premium mismatch across systems.
On FAIL, re-run the calculation on the filed version and reconcile the three systems; the Senior Underwriter reviews before bind.
Filed rate/rule version effective on the policy date (edition id on the worksheet).
Exposures from the confirmed schedule; base rates and factor tables from the filed rating version loaded in Earnix.

Fields defined in the rating data dictionary (exposure_base, base_rate, factor, coverage_premium, tax_fee, total_premium); control total = sum(coverage_premium) + tax_fee equals total_premium across Earnix/PolicyCenter/billing with 0 variance.
